assignment_algorithm.name: balanced_atomic_units_with_exact_small_stratum_audit
assignment_algorithm.role_count_objective: maximize the weakest role by minimizing the range in atomic-unit counts; when the total is not divisible by three, protect SOURCE_VALID and then SOURCE_TEST before REF_TRAIN
assignment_algorithm.small_stratum_search: enumerate every role assignment; for 8 Native_American units this is 3^8=6561 candidates
exact_lexicographic_objective: minimum SOURCE_VALID versus SOURCE_TEST atomic-unit-count difference
minimum squared sample-count deviation from equal thirds
sha256 tie break over the private assignment
assignment_algorithm.order_units: descending number of populations, descending sample count, ascending sha256 of sorted private member IDs
assignment_algorithm.large_stratum_assignment: within balanced unit quotas, greedily minimize population fill, then sample fill, then fixed role order
assignment_algorithm.ratio_screen: exact for Native_American; balanced thirds are selected because they maximize the minimum number of independent atomic units available to any role

gates.F0: The M27E manifest authenticates all 22 IBD files, 22 maps and the frozen strata; identities and counts match.
gates.F1: All 128 NatWGS samples and their complete canonical-population/primary-IBD closure are quarantined in DISCOVERY.
gates.F2: No individual, canonical population or primary IBD block crosses roles, and no mixed-ancestry atomic unit is assigned.
gates.F3: AFR, EUR and NAM each retain at least two atomic units and two populations in each source role.
gates.F4: No VCF, genotype, rare-support, position, baseline-overlap or LAI result is an input to the split.
gates.F5: Per ancestry, assigned atomic-unit counts satisfy the preregistered balanced-role objective; every small stratum is exhaustively enumerated.
gates.F6: Assignment is invariant to input order; public outputs contain no sample IDs or population labels.

next_gate: Extract REF_TRAIN only with a positive sample allow-list; verify that DISCOVERY, SOURCE_VALID and SOURCE_TEST contribute zero columns; derive the candidate catalog from the 954 discovery-frozen sites in REF_TRAIN before opening SOURCE_VALID once.

amendments.timing: before the final split and before any M27F genotype access
amendments.reason: Authenticate the exact M27E metadata and IBD inputs and remove VCF headers from the role-assignment interface.
amendments.delta: Derive the discovery identities from the frozen strata, authenticate 46 upstream inputs through the M27E manifest, and prohibit VCF or genotype access during assignment.

amendments.timing: after the first metadata-only balanced split and its Council POST review, before any M27F genotype access
amendments.reason: Only eight Native-American atomic units remain after discovery quarantine, so an undeclared greedy tie break could materially change the effective replication.
amendments.delta: Retain the original balanced-thirds objective, enumerate all 3^8 Native-American assignments, protect validation and test when thirds are not exact, and use a canonical hash only for otherwise identical assignments. No genotype, rare support, position, baseline or LAI result was available.
